coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Use the end-view coordinate convention: XY is the end-view plane and Z is the sleeve longitudinal axis. Section A-A uses view-local X for this same longitudinal axis and view-local Y for the transverse height; its cut-normal Z is therefore a local view designation, not world Z. Section B-B supplies the local tooth profile. No datum-based origin is established.

features.name: Central through bore
features.description: Continuous longitudinal through bore running along the component axis with corner breaks at each bore entry.

features.name: Knurl detail
features.description: Straight knurl / serration tooth profile, 28-32 places equally spaced at both ends.

geometry.position_description: Equally spaced at both ends of the component

features.name: Sleeve overall body
features.description: Full-length tubular sleeve body with length dimension specified under knurls between opposing end faces.

features.name: End shoulders
features.description: Raised cylindrical collars/shoulders located at both ends of the sleeve.

features.name: Central outer cylinder
features.description: Main central cylindrical outside diameter between the two end shoulders.

features.name: Shoulder transition fillets
features.description: Internal corner fillets at the transition from central cylinder Ø26.90 to both end shoulders Ø31.43.

relationships.detail: The longitudinal through bore and central outside cylinder share the sleeve centerline.
Both cylindrical end shoulders are centered on the longitudinal bore axis.
The central outside cylinder and the end shoulders share the longitudinal sleeve axis.
The end view places the annular serration pattern around the central bore center.
The B-B detail defines equally spaced knurl teeth at both ends; the end shoulders explicitly reference that detail.
The transition fillets join the central outside cylinder at its shoulder transitions.
The transition fillets join the end shoulders to the central outside cylinder.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum definitions or GD&T feature control frames are supplied. A-A and B-B are section identifiers, while the inspection and revision balloons do not establish datums.

assumptions.text: Grouped end_view:F1 with section_aa:F5 using the A-A cut-through-center-axis correspondence and their central-bore descriptions. This identity is provisional pending C01; the incompatible diameter callouts have not been treated as truncation or resolved by selecting a nominal.

Selected section_aa:F5 as the provisional bore canonical because the longitudinal section provides the more complete bore observation and directly establishes the THRU condition. This selection does not authorize machining while C01 remains unresolved.

Grouped end_view:F2 with section_bb:F1 through the explicit B-B cross-reference. Selected the enlarged B-B detail as canonical because it provides the tooth-profile definition; the parent end view supplies the annular boundaries.

Retained section_aa:F3 as a separate feature from the knurl group. The smooth central outside cylinder and the serrated end-face zone are distinct physical regions despite a coincident reported diameter.

Retained the paired shoulders and paired transition fillets as their existing interchangeable-instance observations. No individually distinguished counterparts are supplied, so no aggregate-reference splitting is needed.

Interpreted B-B as the tooth-profile detail for the radial end-face serrations identified in the parent view. Its request for an axial engagement length was not treated as an independently missing straight-knurl length, and no axial extent was invented.
Adopted the end-view world-axis convention and treated section A-A coordinates as view-local coordinates describing the same sleeve axis.
Treated ASME Y14.5M-1994 as the supplied dimensioning and tolerancing interpretation standard, not as a source of numerical default tolerances for untoleranced dimensions.
The two bore-entry corner breaks shown in Section A-A are 45° chamfers.

The Ø20.75/19.75 callout applies to the bore entrance chamfer (corner break) at the end face, which defines the inner boundary of the face knurl, whereas the Ø16.4/16.1 callout in section A-A specifies the through-bore diameter.

Dimensions lacking an explicit tolerance, such as Ø 26.90, R 2.00, and the 50° angle, are assumed to be governed by standard title block general tolerances in accordance with ASME Y14.5. Under this standard, untoleranced features follow general decimal-place tolerances (typically ±0.13 mm / ±0.010 in for two decimal places and ±1° for angles).
